title: N -W F P Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE GOVERNMENT SERVANTS
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE GOVERNMENT SERVANTS
BENEVOLENT FUND
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE NO. XVI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the North‑West
Frontier Province Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary,17th August, 2001]
No. Legis. 1(25)/71/4194‑99,
dated 17‑8‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
